### 문서
- `SKILL.md` — Keeps living documents free of inline history — a corrected artifact states only its current state; the what-moved-where-and-why belongs in commits and ADRs. Use when annotating a fix or relocation with its history ('this used to be...') outside history-purposed docs, when transition banners spread across docs, or when writing a subagent prompt that tells it to mark changes in the artifact.
